title: Surface overflow rate for a real grit chamber basin

symbols.definition: Desired efficiency of removal of grit particle
Settling velocity of minimum size of grit particle to be removed
Design surface over flow rate applicable for grit chamber to be designed
An index which is a measure of the basin performance.

applicability: Equation used to determine the surface overflow rate (SOR) for a real basin for a given efficiency of grit removal and basin performance.
notes: The printed exponent is 1/n with no minus sign; printed as shown and not corrected.
The values of n are 1/8, 1/4, 1/2 and 1 for very good, good, poor and very poor performance.
As printed, the equation yields design surface overflow rates of 66.67%, 58.8%, 50% and 33.3% of the settling velocity for 75% removal efficiency.
